en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
When the flow of urine stops, so pour the water (upon it’s discharging part)’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan all from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil who has said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
when the gushing out of urine stops, you can pour water to wash it clean.”
